comment: The ONE plugin manifest: plugin ids -> npm package. Every plugin's version is gateway_release (versions follow the pin; a pin bump changes gateway_release only). Baked into the image at build time (build-gateway-image.yml -> OPENCLAW_PLUGIN_SPECS = package@pin); route-c-deploy's preflight and step 4b2 (scripts/ci/check-plugin-manifest.sh) align state-resident installs to it; reconcile-openclaw-plugins.sh builds first-install specs from it. Keys are plugins.entries keys. "bundled" plugins ship inside the gateway runtime: no package, nothing to install. Epic #3790 item 3 (#3804).
